system.description: Also at 2nd level, while they were partying, you hardened your fists. While they were making hand signs, you learned to punch holes in steel. While they played mind games with Genjutsu, you kicked the tree 1000 times. Now that they are in battle and they can’t take a punch, they have the audacity to come to you. So be it. Select one of the following Paths of Perfection. These paths represent your hard work. Your tenacity and your technique. Some paths interact with Taijutsu stances in unique ways.
